thread:
Sam: FYI the nightly kernel pick sweep flagged a suspicious pick on Ampere for seqlen=128. putting notes here for triage.
perf-bot: run started: /opt/prober/pickwalk --suite=candidate --arch=ampere,h100 --seqlens=16,32,64,128,512,2048 --out=s3://prober/runs/1717801234 
perf-bot: excerpt: [INFO] arch=ampere seqlen=128 candidate=k_v7 median=7.4ms p95=12.2ms baseline=k_v3 median=8.0ms p95=10.1ms verdict=pick
perf-bot: [WARN] kv_prefill: miss_rate=0.19 for k_v7 -> correlates with p95 tail under burst loads
perf-bot: [ERROR] arch=h100 seqlen=2048 candidate=k_w3 flakiness=0.37 (11/30 fails) -> unstable
Lia: short repro? what pattern shows the tail?
Sam: simple ramp pattern: start single requests then ramp to batch sizes 4 and 8. first ~4 tokens after ramp show elevated latency and higher kv miss rate for k_v7.
Mohit: sounds like a prefetch/eviction mismatch in k_v7. it fills the KV cache slower when the logical window increases quickly.
Alyssa: current gating was `median < baseline*0.95 && p95 < baseline*1.15`. that allows some tail regressions through.
Sam: propose new gating: require median <= baseline*0.98 AND p95 <= baseline*1.05 AND stdev <= 0.03. also require a stability pass across patterns (single / burst / ramp).
Mohit: add a fast microbench `kv-prefill` that runs short prefixes [0,32,128,512] and reports first-token p95 + kv_miss_rate. keep it ~30s per kernel so CI can pre-gate.
perf-bot: queued kv-prefill for k_v7 on ampere -> first-token p95 at prefix=32 is 2.1x baseline; miss_rate=0.21. logs uploaded.
Lia: if kv-prefill fails for an arch/seqlen, mark candidate unstable and skip nightly sweep for that combo.
Alyssa: CI plan: 1) add `kv-prefill` microbench as pre-gate in candidate-ci, 2) tighten gating logic, 3) run 10 stability repeats across patterns and fail if >3 runs exceed p95 threshold, 4) enable `--trace-on-fail` to capture KV metrics + kernel histograms to S3.
Sam: I'll open a PR to pickwalk defaults + add microbench binary under harness/microbench. will include an integration test for warmup prefixes.
Mohit: also add a short JSON summary exporter for failed candidates: {arch,seqlen,candidate,median,p95,kv_miss_rate,prefix} so triage tools can surface hotspots quickly.
Lia: H100 flaky runs look related to buffer churn for seqlen>1024. filing infra ticket #infra/h100-buffer-churn with traces.
Alyssa: ticket created and linked to run artifacts. cc @eng-oncall. we should prioritize if failures block nightly.
Sam: implementation notes: update pickwalk gating thresholds, add `--kv-prefill` flag, wire pre-gate step in candidate-ci.yaml, add `--trace-on-fail` upload and JSON summary.
perf-bot: will re-run quick prechecks after PR merges and then kick off full nightly if pre-gates pass.
Sam: TL;DR — median win for k_v7 but KV prefill/stability show tail regressions on Ampere. action: tighten gates, add kv-prefill microbench + stability runs, rerun candidates.
ci-bot: quick recheck queued post-merge.
